host_timing_note: Measured on the FreeRTOS POSIX port, where every task is a thread of a Linux process. Times, jitter and latencies are those of the host's scheduler and are not what the same code shows on a microcontroller; counts, orderings and sizes of protocol data are independent of the host. The frames, their lengths and the nominal load are protocol data and do not depend on the host; the frames per second do, through when the node's tasks ran, and the node's frames are paced by its controller model at 500 kbit/s while the tester's frames reach the observer when the tester sends them, not when a real bus would carry them.
